convert_youtubevis_to_coco: run the youtubevis2coco script to convert YouTube-VIS annotations to COCO video format
convert_vis_train: convert YouTube-VIS 2019 or 2021 train dataset annotations to COCO style JSON format
convert_vis_validation: convert YouTube-VIS validation dataset annotations to COCO style JSON format with bounding boxes
convert_vis_test: convert YouTube-VIS test dataset annotations to COCO style JSON format without annotations
parse_args_cli: parse command line arguments for input directory, output directory, and dataset version
